title: An object of D(R) with vanishing positive cohomology and flat localizations at f and at R over fR is a flat module in degree zero
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma is a flatness criterion for an object M of D(R) given two local conditions: vanishing cohomology above degree 0, and the derived tensor products with R_f and with R over fR being flat modules placed in degree 0 (statement lines 30032-30043). The proof has to check two distinct and not obviously related conditions for the object N = M tensor^L K, namely the vanishing of the f-localized cohomology in negative degrees, which is computed through the factorization of the derived tensor product along R_f, and the vanishing of the cohomology of the cone of multiplication by f below degree -1, which is computed by writing the cone as a derived tensor product with the cone on K and using the triangle with K[f] and K over fK (proof lines 30054-30079). The two hypotheses on M are used in exactly one place each, and the argument is carried out for an arbitrary test module K, so the reduction is the substantive step. The counted span refers to one lemma and one section of this chapter; the computations themselves are inside the span.
